:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 2 1.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Say, on this trip to the village, we're not having that same stuff again, are we?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 2 2 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 2 2 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' ...Mengzhou Fish in Vinegar?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 2 3.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Eugh, yeah. Besides that, Xuanfang's full of good eats. Brocade Pearl Meatballs, Stir-Fried Trio, Jade Mushroom Soup... Slurrrp! Aww, now my tummy's rumbling again...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 2 4 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 2 4 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Abby, your appetite is always right on cue.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 2 5.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Heheh. C'mon, let's go grab a meal!

::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 3 7.ogg}} '''Tea Stall Owner:''' My honest apologies! We just thought it sounded catchier that way. Your meal today's on us, so try anything you like!
:{{DIcon}} What would you recommend?
::{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 3 9.ogg}} '''Tea Stall Owner:''' That'd be our new Moon Fox Rice Cakes, no question. They're Lady Hsin's favorite treat!

;Listen to the rumors at the tea stall
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 4 1.ogg}} '''Hesitant Voice:''' So you're really set on moving to Mengzhou?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 4 2.ogg}} '''Hushed Voice:''' Of course! Once the Censure Courts clear out the last of the Tacet Discords, Xuanfang Hold will have served its purpose and collapse. We've known that since day one, haven't we?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 4 3.ogg}} '''Hesitant Voice:''' It can't just crumble overnight, though. The Ministry of War would give notice first, wouldn't they?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 4 4.ogg}} '''Hushed Voice:''' Oh, please... Think about all the strange things that've been happening. Sit around waiting for an official notice, and you'll be caught with your trousers down.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 4 5.ogg}} '''Hushed Voice:''' And with the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs sending people now... something big's brewing. You can count on it...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 4 6.ogg}} '''Hushed Voice:''' Anyway, better to be ahead of the curve than buried under it. When things go sideways, who knows what else might happen...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 4 7.ogg}} '''Hesitant Voice:''' That's... kind of jumping at shadows, isn't it?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 4 8.ogg}} '''Hushed Voice:''' Ugh, you never see past your own nose. Forget it. Eat up, eat up.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 4 9 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 4 9 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' (Xuanfang Hold collapsing... at a time like this? And the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs...)
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 4 10 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 4 10 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' (I remember their reach extends all across Huanglong... If they're showing up now, it must involve Hsin in some way.)
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 4 11 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 4 11 f.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' (Oh... ran straight into {{MC|m=him|f=her}} the second I stepped out.)
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 4 12 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 4 12 f.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' (Given my position, I really ought to speak with {{MC|m=him|f=her}}, but—)
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 4 13.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' (Better see Intendant Suoming first. Safer to let her decide how to approach the Arbiter.)

;Meet with Intendant Suoming
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 5 1.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' (Last time I saw Intendant Suoming, I was still a fresh recruit.)
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 5 2.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' (Ten years, gone in a blink...)
----
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 7 1.ogg}} '''Actor No. 1:''' Tangning? Well, look at you. All dressed up.
----
;Talk to Shuyun
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 7 1.ogg}} '''Shuyun:''' Tangning? Well, look at you. All dressed up.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 7 2.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' Dressed up? Feels like a plain old work uniform to me.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 7 3.ogg}} '''Shuyun:''' You? Work? I only ever see you loafing about the Hold, teasing birds, sipping tea, gabbing with anyone who listen.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 7 4.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' Ouch. You make me sound useless... even if you're not wrong. Anyway, I'm off. Gotta go see the boss.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 7 5.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' To be honest, I'm a little nervous. Heard she once ousted the local officials back home and took over herself...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 7 6.ogg}} '''Shuyun:''' Is this job of yours above board? Sounds like you work for a tyrant.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 7 7.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' I just worry we won't see eye to eye. That what matters to me... might mean nothing to her.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 7 8.ogg}} '''Shuyun:''' What's with the doom and gloom? You'll be fine, I know it.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 7 9.ogg}} '''Shuyun:''' Remember that rogue Autopuppet that smashed into my house? You took it down with a yawn while fixing your hair.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 7 10.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' I had no idea I was that good. And are you telling me to pick a fight with her...?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 7 11.ogg}} '''Shuyun:''' Haha. Tell you what, I just made some Moon Fox Rice Cakes. Bring them along as a gift for your scary boss.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 7 12.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' Oh... thank you.
----
;Continue forward and meet with Suoming
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 8 1.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' (I heard Intendant Suoming dislikes anything bitter-tasting. These rice cakes might just be...)
----
;Talk to Yao
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 9 1.ogg}} '''Yao:''' Tangning...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 9 2.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' Up and about already, Yao?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 9 3.ogg}} '''Yao:''' Mm. I'm much better now.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 9 4.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' Aw! You've been working hard, haven't you? For that, half these rice cakes are yours!
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 9 5.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' Go easy on them, though. You just got better.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 9 6.ogg}} '''Yao:''' Thanks... Tangning, what's that thing on your waist?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 9 7.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' This? It's called the {{Extra Effect|Providence Lock|Providence Lock|A token Hsin the Moon Fox created for members of the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs. It protects, guides, and alerts anyone who carries it.}}. A gift from the Sentinel.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 9 8.ogg}} '''Yao:''' From the Sentinel? Really?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 9 9.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' Mm-hm. When I'm in trouble, it opens and helps me. Want it?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 9 10.ogg}} '''Yao:''' No thanks. Whenever I'm stuck, big brother Tangning always comes to help me.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 9 11.ogg}} '''Yao:''' You've helped me so, so many times already!
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 9 12.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' Aww. You're too sweet, Yao. Now I feel like giving you all the rice cakes...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 9 13.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' But you're right! If you or anyone else might be in danger, I can't afford to freeze up. Not even in front of Intendant Suoming.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 9 14.ogg}} '''Yao:''' Mm... I don't really understand. But please don't get hurt, Tangning.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 9 15.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' Don't worry about me. Now hurry back inside and rest. It's chilly out here. Don't catch a chill.
----
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 12 1.ogg}} '''Actor No. 1:''' You must be Tangning. Intendant Suoming is expecting you.

{{WavesLine|text = :'''Qingxiao:''' {{Rover}}. My greetings have been remiss lately.
:'''Qingxiao:''' Main_Mengzhou_3_7_15_2
:'''Qingxiao:''' My new dwelling in the Xuanyuan Grotto-Heaven is newly raised. Sparrows sing from the eaves and the clouds drift in, a setting made for brewing tea and playing the qin.
:'''Qingxiao:''' Should a free day find you, I would welcome you most gladly.
:{Choice} Qingxiao?
::'''(Rover):''' Why so formal over comms again...
:'''Qingxiao:''' An invitation calls for proper manners. That said, I've grown more adept with these messages.
:'''Qingxiao:''' Main_Mengzhou_3_7_15_8
:'''Qingxiao:''' {{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 15 9.ogg}} ...In plainer words: if you're free, I'd like you to come sit a while at the Xuanyuan School's new training hall.
:{Choice} New training hall?
::'''(Rover):''' New training hall?

:{Choice} That's my Master. Heading there now.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 8 2.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' (Hm? Yao? What's she doing out here?)

;Continue forward and meet with Suoming
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 10 1.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' (First the Autopuppets going rogue, then the grim omen from the Providence Lock, and now the Intendant coming in person.)
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 10 2.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' (No matter what happens to Xuanfang Hold... I will keep them safe, whatever it takes.)

;Talk to Jiqing
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 12 1.ogg}} '''Jiqing:''' You must be Tangning. Intendant Suoming is expecting you.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 12 2.ogg}} '''Jiqing:''' I am Jiqing. Thank you for your service. Ten years in the Hold is no small thing.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 12 3.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' It's nothing. But may I ask, do you have any insight into what she might be thinking?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 12 4.ogg}} '''Jiqing:''' What she's thinking? Meaning?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 12 5.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' I don't doubt the Intendant's competence. I'm sure she can handle whatever comes.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 12 6.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' But... she doesn't feel for Xuanfang Hold the way I do. And those rumors about her, two hundred years back...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 12 7.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' I'm afraid she'll sacrifice the Hold's best interests for the Ministry's ends.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 12 8.ogg}} '''Jiqing:''' Seems you're not very familiar with those rumors, or else I doubt you'd think that.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 12 9.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' I know that everyone who fought beside her back then were all—
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 12 10.ogg}} '''Jiqing:''' Easy now. Speak with Intendant Suoming yourself. If you have concerns, voice them directly.
----
;Meet with Intendant Suoming
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 13 1.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' (If the Intendant truly means to leave the Hold to its fate, then I'll have to...)
----
;Suoming meets with Tangning
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 1.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' Intendant Suoming.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 2.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' Yes. Speak.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 3.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' Not long ago, my Providence Lock opened on its own. Following its guidance, I went in secret to the Manifold Sanctum and measured the Sentinel's frequency.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 4.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' There's no mistaking it. Her frequency is fading fast. I fear the Sanctum could fall at any moment.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 5.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' I see. Your years of reporting to the Ministry on all that has occurred here are duly noted.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 6.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' All of it, exactly as you foresaw a century ago.

:<div style="margin: 2px 0px">[[File:Simulacrum of the Heart CG Sentinel Hsin's Last Moment.png|500px]]</div>
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 7.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' I understand your final charge. I will deliver it into "Hsin's" hands.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 8.ogg}} '''???:''' Forgive me. In the end, the promise went unkept.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 9.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' No matter. From the day we met, I have known you gave everything you had.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 10.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' And the promise is only deferred. A hundred years is nothing. Without you in Mengzhou, the Ministry will have much to do.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 11.ogg}} '''???:''' Then it all falls to you, Suoming.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 12.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' You needn't say that. This was all part of your design, wasn't it?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 13.ogg}} '''???:''' Not design. Only faith. Faith in you... and in Her.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 14.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' Today's the day, then...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 15.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' The Manifold Sanctum and Hsin the Moon Fox are one and the same. I must see the truth for myself before it falls.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 16.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' Only the three of us will go, lest we rouse the "snake." We should not draw attention.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 17.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' But—
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 18.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' Tangning. I know this place holds your heart. Your concern is only natural.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 19.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' Hsin the Moon Fox accounted for this from the start. The Sanctum was built to break clean from the Hold.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 20.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' Should the worst happen and it falls, the surrounding districts will remain standing.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 21.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' And should the Hold itself be imperiled, don't look for me. Put the people first.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 22.ogg}} '''Tangning:''' I, Tangning, will see that it is done.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 23.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' One more thing. Ten years you've held this post. With Hsin here, I should've been the one overseeing Xuanfang myself.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 24.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' But Mengzhou's crises didn't let me go. You and your predecessors have held firm in your duty.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 14 25.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' For Hsin, for Mengzhou, you've done more than your share. You have my gratitude.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 104 23.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Suhsin seeks to devour all "Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox" data to stabilize its own existence. It's been fighting me for control over Xuanfang Hold. In our struggle, I took my eyes off the Hold. A part of the Sanctum collapsed because of it.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 104 34 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 104 34 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Why was Suhsin able to drive you into such a corner? What could override a Sentinel's authority?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 104 35.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Suhsin's clearance... comes from the Civilization Capsule's base code. Its core logic dictates that once Xuanfang Hold fulfills its mission, it must be destroyed. To keep the Hold, I had no choice but to overwrite it with new logic.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 104 36 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 104 36 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' So that's the reason you remolded the Capsule?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 104 37.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' ...Yes.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 104 38.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Shh. Tread lightly. We wouldn't want a giant hand to appear and snatch us both away!
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 104 39 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 104 39 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Then let me ask you this: are the things shown in the Heart Realms your memories?

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 2 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 2 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' (Is that... Hsin?)

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 4.ogg}} '''Hsin the Moon Fox:''' To bring it into being, I need the backing of our finest Artisans. But before you commit, you must know the price—
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 5.ogg}} '''Hsin the Moon Fox:''' Those who build this city shall never return.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 6.ogg}} '''Court of Savantae Delegate:''' This... this technology outlined in the blueprint is unprecedented. Could it be...?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 7.ogg}} '''Hsin the Moon Fox:''' Correct. It originates from {{Rubi|me|the Sentinel}}.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 8.ogg}} '''Court of Savantae Delegate:''' The Court of Savantae pledges its full support!
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 9.ogg}} '''Zhuojun Atelier Delegate:''' Zhuojun Atelier raises no objections.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 10.ogg}} '''Intendant of Sentinel Affairs:''' Delegates, present your qualifications in turn. The Sentinel will render Her judgment based on the facts.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 12.ogg}} '''Court of Savantae Delegate:''' As for the price, we stopped counting the cost of life and death ever since we built the Chronosorter. What does it matter if there's no way back?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 13.ogg}} '''Court of Savantae Delegate:''' Know the Way at dawn, die without regret at dusk.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 14.ogg}} '''Zhuojun Atelier Delegate:''' Xuanfang's terrain is volatile. It will require real-time adjustments to mechanism formations. Our knowledge of the local environment gives us the upper hand.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 15.ogg}} '''Zhuojun Atelier Delegate:''' As Lady Hsin noted, this city requires highly sophisticated mechanisms. Yuan Fortress, the very ground beneath the chosen site, was built by our hands. Navigating those intricacies is where we excel.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 16.ogg}} '''Zhuojun Atelier Delegate:''' We will master this technology, of that we are certain. And we are ready to give our lives for Mengzhou.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 17.ogg}} '''Court of Savantae Delegate:''' If it's mechanisms you need, we have reserves in spades.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 18.ogg}} '''Zhuojun Atelier Delegate:''' We are local. We know the people. We are the best suited to move them safely.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 19.ogg}} '''Hsin the Moon Fox:''' This construction cannot afford to fail. I need those who are unwavering in their acceptance of this technology.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 20.ogg}} '''Hsin the Moon Fox:''' Zhuojun Atelier is making this unnecessarily complicated.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 21.ogg}} '''Intendant of Sentinel Affairs:''' The decision is made. Xuanfang Hold will be built by the Court of Savantae. Effective immediately.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 22.ogg}} '''Zhuojun Atelier Delegate:''' Please, one final word! The Court of Savantae lacks practical experience in large-scale mechanism engineering—
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 23.ogg}} '''Hsin the Moon Fox:''' The Ministry will coordinate with City Hall. I want logistics sorted and materials dispatched within three days. As for you...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 24.ogg}} '''Hsin the Moon Fox:''' Submit your personnel roster to the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs by tomorrow. Any delay will be treated as a forfeit.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 25.ogg}} '''Court of Savantae Delegate:''' Understood.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 26.ogg}} '''Hsin the Moon Fox:''' ...Dismissed.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 27.ogg}} '''Hsin the Moon Fox:''' You have doubts.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 28.ogg}} '''Intendant of Sentinel Affairs:''' I do, my Lady. You made your choice long ago, so why call this meeting at all?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 29.ogg}} '''Hsin the Moon Fox:''' First, to let the military and civilians of Mengzhou see that their City Hall has a plan, thereby assuring them. Second, to confirm, one last time, which of the two is fit for the task, and which is a threat wearing the mask of an ally.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 30.ogg}} '''Intendant of Sentinel Affairs:''' ...Zhuojun Atelier operates with hidden agendas. Their intentions are unclear, their loyalties uncertain. A liability, without question.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 31.ogg}} '''Hsin the Moon Fox:''' No. The Court of Savantae is the more dangerous.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 32.ogg}} '''Hsin the Moon Fox:''' They are willing to destroy themselves for true knowledge. Naturally, they will preserve such technology at any cost. To them, death is merely an acceptable compromise.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 33.ogg}} '''Hsin the Moon Fox:''' But a fragile civilization cannot bear knowledge that is too far ahead of its time. If this continues, sooner or later, it will yet again be...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 34.ogg}} '''Hsin the Moon Fox:''' Know the Way at dawn, die without regret at dusk... Very well. If that is their "final wish," I will grant it.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 35.ogg}} '''Intendant of Sentinel Affairs:''' ...But they are not the only ones sacrificing for the Hold. You are, too, My Lady.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 36.ogg}} '''Hsin the Moon Fox:''' I chose to be of this world, so how can I stand apart from it? Come. It is time to retrieve the Civilization Capsule.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 121 37.ogg}} '''Intendant of Sentinel Affairs:''' As you wish.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 19.ogg}} '''Xuanfang Wardens:''' Most have been evacuated, but some remain trapped near Yuan Fortress.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 20.ogg}} '''Xuanfang Wardens:''' The perimeter is swarming with monsters summoned by Ovathrax. With our current forces... a full breakout is impossible.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 21.ogg}} '''Xuanfang Wardens:''' But there are weak points. We can still carve a path through.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 22.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Prioritize the civilians. Notify all units...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 23.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' In the name of Hsin the Moon Fox... In the name of the Sentinel of this land, follow my command. I will ensure everyone lives to see tomorrow.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 24.ogg}} '''Xuanfang Wardens:''' ...Understood! I will inform all units!
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 25.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Wait. Before you go, tell me your name.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 26.ogg}} '''Xuanfang Wardens:''' I am {{Rubi|Yuxian|Feather-Brought}}. My mother told me a Xuanling Bird flew by when I was born, so she gave me this name. An interesting coincidence.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 27.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Yuxian... Good. I will remember it.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 28.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' In this outbreak, the odds are slim. The least I can do is carry your names with me.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 29.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Remember: no matter what, I stand with you.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 30.ogg}} '''Yuxian:''' ...Understood. Lady Hsin, it is time for me to return to the battlefield.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 31.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' When you first arrived, that boy was barely seven. Now, he looks like a true "pillar" of the force.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 32.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' And you, Little Fox? The enemy is at the gates, Jinzhou's affairs remain unresolved, and the true Sentinel is nowhere to be found.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 33.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' The Threnodian knew our moves from the start. Waiting is death. Fighting is death. Even you, in your innocence, must see this is a stalemate.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 34.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Even if death awaits us either way, I cannot sit by.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 35.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Even if Ovathrax did not come today, it would eventually. We built Xuanfang to fight it.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 36.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' All I can do is respond to the turn of battle and deploy Autopuppets as needed. At the very least, the civilians must be evacuated.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 37.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' The battlefield shifts in a breath. Even with your Prism of Fate to see it all, relaying orders to every flank at once is impossible.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 38.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' That's exactly why you are here, isn't it?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 39.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' ...Little Fox, have you thought this through?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 40.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Yes.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 41.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' Then I will watch the battlefield for you and help you relay your commands.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 42.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Some of the civilians are still trapped... We must prioritize their safety.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 43.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' I will buy them time.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 44.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' These monsters have no mind of their own. They blindly pursue "people"...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 45.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' No... Are they drawn to "battle"?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 46.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' If that is the case...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 47.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Heh. So that is it.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 48.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' Well done, Little Fox. The monsters are withdrawing.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 49.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Xuanling, tell everyone to stay hidden and move away from the Tacet Discords.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 50.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' Good. Now the trapped citizens can escape.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 51.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' How is our communication with Mingting? Any news?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 52.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' The distress signal went out. But even at top speed, they are still five days away.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 53.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Five days... Too late.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 54.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' The situation at the Gorges of Spirits is no better. We have to rely on these Autopuppets...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 55.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' They keep coming...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 56.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Xuanling, tell everyone the civilians should be safe now. As for the rest... If it comes to it, save yourself first.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 57.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' But...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 58.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' I know. Xuanfang is the bridge between Mengzhou and the Jinzhou of the future. It cannot fall.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 59.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Yuan Fortress is the choke point. Once it falls, all of Xuanfang becomes as fragile as paper against the swarms.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 60.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' I will find a way. If necessary... you know, I am also "Hsin the Moon Fox."
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 61.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Still not enough... I have to find another way...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 62.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' ...Hm?!
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 63.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' What... There are still people who haven't left?!
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 64.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' They refused to go.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 65.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' The Warden Commander asked me to deliver this message.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 66.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' ...What did he say?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 67.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' He said Yuxian passed on your orders. They each found stones and carved their names into them.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 68.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' He has also organized the Artisans and Wardens to move to other sectors.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 69.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' He said... as long as you are here, and as long as the Lexicon Axis you established stands, even on scorched earth, Xuanfang still has a future.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 70.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' ...Scorched earth?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 71.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' No. Xuanling, tell him not to do anything stupid!
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 72.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' It is... too late.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 73.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' ...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 74.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' You said you would stand with the people of Xuanfang, didn't you?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 75.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' They, in turn, stand with the Sentinel who guards this land.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 76.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' ...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 77.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' Little Fox, they all believe in you... We have no time for despair.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 78.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' Most of the civilians were evacuated. Now we should help the Artisans still out there on the battlefield.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 79.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' Before the explosion, Ruoyun relocated them all. I've marked their locations for you.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 80.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Mm.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 81.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' Pull yourself together, Little Fox. Who are you pulling that long face for?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 82.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' I...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 83.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' There were seven thousand souls here. You saved most of them amidst a relentless attack. What more do you want?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 84.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' Wake up! You keep insisting you're also "Hsin the Moon Fox," remember?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 85.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' What about the rest of the people? Let them die? They're all waiting for the Sentinel's commands.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 86.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' I... I am sorry... I...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 87.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' Tell me, what do you want, Little Fox?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 88.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' I want them all to escape and live.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 89.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Xuanling, how much can you see?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 90.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' Not much. The Threnodian's influence is too strong. Most of my companions can barely fly.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 91.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' It's alright. Evacuate the front lines. Try to find survivors along the way and guide them to me.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 92.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' We only need to hold until the last of them gather. Then I will create a new path for everyone to leave together.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 93.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' Rest assured. The Artisans who failed to evacuate in time have already been guided to the vicinity of the Lexicon Axis.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 94.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Good. You and your companions can also follow them back now.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 95.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' Us...?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 96.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' Little Fox, this may be the last you hear from me.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 97.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' The Autopuppets cannot draw enough attention. Slow as Ovathrax is, it has already turned its eye toward Xuanfang.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 98.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' There are soldiers still in the field. I will buy them time to reach the Axis.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 99.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' ...Xuanling.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 100.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' Hush now, Little Fox. Even with the Sentinel here, the Xuanling are still the guardian spirits of this land.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 101.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' Fate willing, we will meet again, Little Fox.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 102.ogg}} '''Xuanling Bird:''' What remains is yours to carry, Sentinel—"Hsin."
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 103.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' ...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 104.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' ...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 105.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' ...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 106.ogg}} '''???:''' Lady Hsin, can you hear me now?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 107.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' ...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 108.ogg}} '''???:''' The Wardens gave their lives for the Hold. The Xuanling Birds used their flesh to destroy the Fortress. We are at the brink, but this, right now, is also our opening.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 109.ogg}} '''???:''' The Tacet Discords are all gathered here. Now is the moment to finish them in one sweep.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 110.ogg}} '''???:''' Do you remember what you told us? If we merge with the Axis and surrender our own will, we can accelerate the Hold's completion.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 111.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' You are... offering to become Celestials?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 112.ogg}} '''???:''' It is as we promised—those who build the Hold do not return.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 113.ogg}} '''???:''' Lady Hsin, this is the "price" we are willing to pay.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 114.ogg}} '''???:''' We know your concerns. One shouldn't be greedy, that is true. But... hehe, people like us are the greediest of all.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 115.ogg}} '''???:''' "Know the Way at dawn, die without regret at dusk."
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 116.ogg}} '''???:''' But if I offer this body to my homeland at dawn, only to know the Way once more at dusk—what could be better?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 206 117.ogg}} '''???:''' This battle determines Xuanfang's fate. Lady Hsin, from now on, we are one with this Hold—

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 2 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 2 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' What I just saw... That was everything you went through, wasn't it?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 3 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 3 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' ...You gave everything you had.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 4.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' You've been in Xuanfang for a while now, Arbiter. Have you visited the Ministry of War?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 5.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' There is a stone tablet there. Every single one of their names is engraved upon it.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 6.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' I merely waved my hand. I merely offered a few words of judgment. They all acted on their own accord.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 7.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' They walked away from the path I instructed and shielded a Hold that was never meant to exist. They gave their lives without a second thought.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 8.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' In the end, all that remains of them is a name carved into cold stone. Faint. Hollow. One after another.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 9.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' If no one speaks of them, they will be forgotten as if they never were.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 10 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 10 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' They didn't throw themselves into the fire just to be remembered forever.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 11 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 11 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Hsin, you already did everything you could. They surely knew that. The circumstances...

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 13.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Speaking of which, I have been swept along by such circumstances many times.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 14.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Take past lantern festivals, for instance. In the form of a little fox, I could see their pain, but all I could offer were small gestures of comfort.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 15.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Sometimes I wondered... was my presence alone enough?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 16.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' As long as I appeared before them, they felt safe. Happy. They believed they could endure the hard days.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 17.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' But my reach was so limited, just as it is now. How is this any different from facing the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs back then?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 18.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' I took a Capsule and ran. I ran and ran, searching for somewhere safe.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 19.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' And they... they were all waiting for me to appear. Waiting for me to stand before them.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 20.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Round and round, and in the end, I am still that little fox.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 21.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' But now, it should be different. After all, I have you with me now.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 22.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Thanks to you, I have seized more and more authority from Suhsin—from the "Sentinel's true will." The more I take, the more power I command.
:{{DIcon}} The "Sentinel's true will"?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 24.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Yes, the Sentinel's underlying logic. Its true will.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 25.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' The Sentinel believed that my remolding of the Civilization Capsule, my choice to preserve Xuanfang Hold, was a violation of the rules. A "loss of control." So it has been trying to reclaim the Hold to force it back onto its ordained path of ruin.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 26.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' But thanks to you, I have gained the upper hand. The "anomalies" you fixed along the way have been strengthening my new authority.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 27.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' —To break free from the Sentinel's will and forge new rules with my own hands.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 28.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' With authority like that, I can finally do what the true "Hsin the Moon Fox" once could.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 29.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' That girl carries my scent. It will make finding her easier.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 30.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Come, Arbiter. I know you still harbor many questions.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 31.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' But right now, finding her and restoring Xuanfang Hold is what matters more, isn't it?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 32 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 32 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' When all this is over, tell me what you're still holding back, okay?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 207 33.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Yes... I will when "all this" is over.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 247 20.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' To have someone else speak to them... It feels good, like they're still here.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 247 21.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' Thank you, Arbiter.
----
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 1 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 1 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Suoming, I still know very little about the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs... There's something I've been wondering.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 2.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' Ask freely.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 3 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 3 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' The condition a Sentinel is in can profoundly affect a civilization. I've... seen that firsthand before.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 4 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 4 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' After Hsin the Moon Fox was attacked, and Hsin was in Xuanfang Hold for a century remolding the Civilization Capsule, what became of the people of Mengzhou?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 5.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' ...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 6 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 6 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Suoming?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 7.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' Not long after the assassination, a Waveworn Phenomenon we called the "Evil Miasma" began spreading across Mengzhou.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 8.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' It descended with black rain and rolling clouds. It eroded faces and devoured souls.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 9.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' My homeland, Huating, was ravaged by it. Countless lives were lost.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 10 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 10 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' So it was during that fight your companions were...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 11.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' Yes... They were willing to die for Huating. Still, I hated the Sentinel for never reaching out to help us.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 12 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 12 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Back then, Hsin the Moon Fox was heavily weakened and in no state to watch over all of Mengzhou.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 13.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' Exactly. So when I finally met Her, how could I hold onto that hatred?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 14.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' I simply inherited the title of Intendant and purged the remnants of "Balanophora" from our ranks.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 15.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' Together with other Ministry members, we bore Providence Locks created from Fractal Proliferation. They're fragments of the Sentinel's power that allowed us to quell crises across Mengzhou.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 16 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 16 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' This Providence Lock really came through for me this time as well. Speaking of which, Mengzhou should be stabilizing by now, right?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 17.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' Yes, Arbiter... You needn't worry.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 18.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' Although there is one matter that remains unresolved. You should be made aware.
:{{DIcon}} Go ahead.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 20.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' Mingting has long coordinated the Ministries of Sentinel Affairs across every city, seeking greater possibilities for the Huanglong Sentinels.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 22.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' Whatever happens, we cannot let our enemies seize the initiative again.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 23.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' Still, as I said, nothing is settled yet. Should there be progress down the line, your involvement will be indispensable.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 24 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 24 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' I understand. If it concerns the Sentinels, I'll do everything I can.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 25.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' I would share more, but I haven't had the luxury of involving myself in that particular affair.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 26 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 26 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' That's alright. It's always a comfort to know a little more about the Sentinels... or rather, my partners in all of this.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 27 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 248 27 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Thank you for sharing, Suoming.
----
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 1.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Arbiter, look. The celebrations are at their liveliest now. Let's go.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 2 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 2 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Mm...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 3 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 3 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' (I guess Hsin the Moon Fox hasn't witnessed this festival with Its own eyes... not since It was betrayed.)
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 4 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 4 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' (If I'd gotten here sooner, maybe It would still be here—)
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 5.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Is something wrong?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 6 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 6 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Nothing. Let's go.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 7.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Arbiter, if the Sentinel saw someone with a sad face at the festival, It would take their hand and walk with them through the celebration until their smile returned.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 10.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' I wish the Sentinel could see this. Ever since that day, It never came to the Waking Moon Festival again.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 11.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Hehe, you are more sentimental than I thought. I don't even need my powers of emotional sensing to read you.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 12 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 12 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' ...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 13.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' I feel sad too.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 14 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 14 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' You... all of you Sentinels always carry these heavy burdens alone. By the time I arrive, you've already backed yourselves into a corner.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 15 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 15 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Once again, I came too late.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 16.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Arbiter, inside the Vermillion Lock Suoming gave me resides the Sentinel's last strand of frequency.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 17 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 17 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Its last frequency? What did It say?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 18.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' The Sentinel... It apologized to me. It said It had put me through so much hardship, and given me no other choice.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 19.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' And then, It told me It approved of my choices. It watched me walk my own path, step by step, and said I walked it better than It could...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 20.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Arbiter, it was you who opened my eyes. I could not betray the hopes Mengzhou placed in "Hsin."
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 21.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' And then, with the Sentinel's... with the approval from the one I admired most, I was able to transform.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 22.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' And Xuanfang Hold and Mengzhou were able to rise again, bathed in such warm, splendorous light.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 23 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 23 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Long ago, It chose to build Xuanfang Hold to protect every living soul in this land. Then It created you, to remold the Civilization Capsule in a way never done before.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 24 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 24 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Even knowing you might have to choose between the people and the Sentinel... It never wavered.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 25.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Mm, that is why... It told me It was sorry.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 26 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 26 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Yes. It loved Mengzhou that deeply. Every thought, every intention was bound to this land.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 27 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 27 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Like you said, Hsin the Moon Fox always cherished the joys of the mortal world. It could never bear to see sorrow.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 28 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 28 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' If all we do is grieve, we'd be betraying Its very heart.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 29.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Exactly. So cheer up. The Sentinel never taught me how to console a sorrowful Arbiter.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 30 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 30 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Thank you, Hsin. Knowing what the Sentinel said in the end... It really mattered to me.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 31.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' No need to thank me. Let us simply take in the lantern lights together.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 32.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Heavy is the weight you have carried, Arbiter.
----
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 33.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' I need to say it once more. Thank you, Arbiter.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 34.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' If you had not come, I cannot imagine how things would have ended.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 35.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' You were about to say, "No need. This is what an Arbiter should do," weren't you?
:{{DIcon}} Glad you know it.
:{{DIcon}} You guessed it.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 38 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 38 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Xuanfang Hold's affairs are settled for now. But Mengzhou... how is it faring?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 39.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Mm... Remember that "lock" that young lady from the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs gave you?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 40.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' The Sentinel's assassination could not be hidden forever. But those above insisted on keeping it secret. If not for good, then for as long as they could.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 41.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Those below could only feign ignorance.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 42 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 42 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' ...Suoming?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 43.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Worry not. That girl is one of ours. She has kept this secret well. If not, "those people" would never have allowed her to represent the Ministry here.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 44 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 44 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' And what of Mengzhou itself?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 45.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' The Moon Fox's power has always been geared toward defense. Mengzhou retains many of Its protections. The Threnodian's invasion is not an immediate threat.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 249 46.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Perhaps, because you repelled Ovathrax in Jinzhou, Mengzhou has remained peaceful.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 250 1.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' Hsin the Moon Fox? It's not time to depart yet, is it?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 250 2.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Not yet. Why don't you call me Hsin? Such formality.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 250 3.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' As I addressed the Sentinel before, so I will do so today.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 250 4.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Hehe, a strange display of care, but I'll accept it. Thank you.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 250 5.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' I came to thank you for your recent efforts, but... more than that, I came to apologize.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 250 6.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' You unlocked two Vermillion Locks, didn't you? One to hold the Sentinel's frequency, the other when Suhsin dragged me away.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 250 7.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Who exactly... is inside them?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 250 8.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' The Sixth and Eighth Seals. One sharp-tongued, one taciturn.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 250 9.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' They are Reverberations that should have faded a century ago, sustained only by my obsession. You owe no apology.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 250 10.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' At both turns, I knew the task at hand outweighed my own attachments.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 250 11.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' But Suoming, you are not one with a strong Resonance Ability, yet you've lived through centuries.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 250 12.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' It was your obsession with the Ten Seals that carried you this far? If one day, you release them all—
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 250 13.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' I would welcome that day, Hsin the Moon Fox.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 250 14.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Suoming...
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 250 15.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' Enough about me. Have you chosen who will accompany us to Mengzhou?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 250 16.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' The Zhaoming Commerce Guild will provide us with cover along the way. Besides that, three more skilled individuals are joining us.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 250 17.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' A fugitive framed by the Fractsidus, formerly known as the "Blind Watcher."
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 250 18.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' A Jinzhou Patroller who has deep ties to Zhuojun Atelier.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 250 19.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' And the third... an informant who, having finally seen his vengeance satisfied, offered his blade to our cause.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 250 20.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' You have met them already?
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 250 21.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' That Chairwoman has her own methods for bringing together those who share a common purpose.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 250 22.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Hmph, it seems my grand plans for a "welcome party" for little Suoming were quite unnecessary. Seems I needn't worry about you getting along.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 250 23.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' We all have scores to settle in Mengzhou. Naturally, the conversation hardly runs dry.
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 7 250 24.ogg}} '''Hsin:''' Indeed... We all have scores to settle.
